## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include a reproduction or screenshots when useful.

- [ ] Public behavior and API changes are documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests cover the change; keyboard and reduced-motion behavior were checked where applicable.
- [ ] No generated archives, credentials, private research or extracted game assets are included.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/KartikeyaKotkar/evoker/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for local setup and the checks relevant to each type of change.
